title: Legacy 'Owner' users become 'Administrator' after migration (Owner merged into Admin)
preconds:
1. Migration to the new roles is complete.
  2. At least one existing user who had the legacy 'Owner' role is present.
steps:
1. Go to Settings > Staff and find a user who previously had the 'Owner' role.
  2. Check the user's assigned role.
  3. Go to Settings > Roles & Permissions and open the Administrator role.
expected:
The user's role is 'Administrator'. There is no separate 'Owner' role - Owner is merged into Administrator.

The Administrator role is editable (it has a pencil icon), except it cannot be changed to lose access to the admin pages.

Only Office User and Time Clock User are fully non-editable.
